name: PR detail Overview shows the PR Brief block with the Generate brief control and the verdict banner
description: From PR #482, the Overview tab (default) renders the PR Brief block (its section label is CSS-uppercased, so the flow waits for 'PR BRIEF'): the Generate brief button is present (AC1) and the newest review's verdict banner shows its PR SCORE label (AC25; the label is the literal 'PR SCORE' in prReview.json, no CSS text-transform). Read-only: the flow never clicks Generate brief because that would call a model; the button is asserted with the `text` action (a bare `find` clicks). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
the PR Brief block renders on Overview (section label is CSS-uppercased)
the Generate brief button is present (asserted, not clicked)
the seeded review's verdict banner renders its score label
